description: AI Video Enhancer — Upscale your clip by 2× or 4×, with optional noise reduction and an MP4 download.. AI Studio run — dispatches to our AI workers (Modal). Credits per run vary by model and file size. Day Pass and welcome credits do not include AI Studio. Files are deleted after processing; auditable at mioffice.ai/account/tasks (retention details at mioffice.ai/privacy). All three credit-based workspaces unlock with the same one-time credit pack — there is no per-workspace subscription. See mioffice.ai/pricing for current plans.
